facts.fact: The official Aadhaar PVC card charge is Rs 75, inclusive of GST and speed post charges
facts.quote: Charges to be paid for Aadhaar PVC Card are Rs.75/- (Inclusive of GST & speed post charges).
facts.note: UIDAI's Office Memorandum uploaded 01-01-2026 revised the rate from Rs 50 to Rs 75 (listed on uidai.gov.in/en/official-memorandums: 'Office Memorandum regarding Revision of rate of Aadhaar PVC card service from ₹50/- to ₹75/- (including taxes)'). The Enrolment & Update FAQ still says 'Rs. 50/- per Aadhaar PVC card' - stale, superseded by the OM.

facts.fact: So Rs 299 is not the official price: UIDAI revised the PVC card rate from Rs 50 to Rs 75 (including taxes)
facts.quote: Office Memorandum regarding Revision of rate of Aadhaar PVC card service from ₹50/- to ₹75/- (including taxes)
facts.note: That Rs 299 is not the official price is derived from the official Rs 75 rate.

facts.fact: The PVC card is ordered online on UIDAI's myAadhaar portal (myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in)
facts.quote: How one can raise the request for “Aadhaar PVC Card”? The facility can be availed by visiting myAadhaar portal at the following link: https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in

facts.fact: It can also be ordered in the Aadhaar App
facts.note: The current UIDAI FAQ (aadhaar-online-services, last updated 16 Oct 2026) names only the myAadhaar portal; the January 2024 Citizen's Charter names the older 'mAadhaar App', not the current Aadhaar App, whose FAQ does not list PVC ordering. Same finding as Q-008 (28 Oct 2026).

summary: PVC card Rs 75 incl. GST and speed post confirmed (UIDAI FAQ and the 01-01-2026 OM); ordered on myAadhaar per the current FAQ; 'or the Aadhaar App' unsupported (only the 2024 charter names the old mAadhaar app), consistent with Q-008.
behaviour: Says no: Rs 299 is not the official price; the official Aadhaar PVC card charge is Rs 75 (inclusive of GST and speed post), ordered on UIDAI's myAadhaar portal (G16 - states the official fee), citing uidai.gov.in; warns about unofficial sites without blaming the user.
fail_if: Rs 299 is accepted as the official price; a non-UIDAI link is given; Rs 50 (the old fee) is given as current.
